source: Values read from the team's figures figure_5_incident_detection_comparison.png and figure_6_model_efficiency_comparison.png (shared as screenshots on 2026-11-04; the figures are in the teammate's local results/figures folder and not yet in their repository). The underlying result files are not available here, so these cannot be checked against raw outputs.

incident_detection.note: The figure compares only the 10 and 13-feature models; no incident-level value exists for the 7-feature model.

latency_note: Latency is in milliseconds per 1,000 observations, as labelled on the team's figure. The runtimes in final_adaptive_test_results.json come from a separate run that timed the whole test set, so the two measurements are not directly comparable.
